items.difficulty_reason: The lemma describes a finitely presented module over a fibre product of rings as a pair of modules over the two factors together with an identification after base change, and the proof is a 46-line construction. It chooses a presentation of the module over the polynomial algebra on the fibre product, writes the presentation matrix in the two blocks corresponding to the two factors, and verifies that the data obtained after base change along each factor determines the module back. The construction of the two modules and the verification that they glue are both displayed.
